note: v5 THE CREST BLOOMS: lock 4 bars, E1 stretto at the fifth 4 bars, then everything at the centre doubles speed (E2 in 32nds, E1 and stretto x0.5, kit micro-edits) for 4 bars
v6 THE SEED, PLAINLY: E1 the right way up at its own speed on an ondes Martenot, nine 5-beat cycles against the bar; the swarm locks in tune, stutters stop, the F chord loses its B
v8 THE CLIMB AND THE GAP: bass rises D F G A under Dm9 Fmaj9 G6/9 A7sus4 (held 6 bars), kick out for 2 bars, 909 snare roll 8ths to 32nds into the crest
v11 THE BREAK CLIMBS OUT: Cmaj9 Fmaj9 G6/9 A7sus4 under the sung line, then the drums return half-time for 4 bars
v12 THE CREST BREATHES IN: bars 53-56 half time, a soft choir (voice-backing, harmony a fifth above) sings E1 slowed on ah, twice; then the double-speed bloom
v13 THE DRUMS FALL INTO THE ORBIT: bars 89-96 the kit plays E2's seven-sixteenth cell (kick, kick, clap) so the backbeat slides round the bar under the ondes' E1
v14 THE ORBIT DECAYS: E1's upside-down cycle turns faster 5 -> 4 -> 3 beats and the hats' cycle 3 -> 2 -> 1 beats into the crest
v16 THE CELL FALLS IN FROM FAR AWAY: E2 slowed x4 then x2 on the log drum from bar 1, landing on the x1 cell at bar 7; on t1's notes D A E C until up to speed

v17 THE ROOM CLEARS FOR THE VOICE: E2 debris stops for the climb out (bars 73-80), a backing choir holds ooh D4 with a keyed third below under the sung line; the debris returns with the half-time drums
v18 THE LIGHT COMES ON: the crest turns D Mixolydian (F to F#), Dadd9 G6/9 Cadd9, back to Dorian at the break
v20 THE DARK BEFORE THE LIGHT: at bar 37 the band drops behind a low-pass and opens bar by bar to full brightness as the crest arrives
v22 THE FALL IN TUNE: E3 itself as the fall's harmony (Dm7 | Bbmaj7 | Csus2 | Dm7, no E or B against t3's Eb); the cell sinks an octave in its own notes instead of sliding a tritone between pitches
v23 THE HEAD BREATHES IN: backing voices ooh on D4 with the open fifth, bars 5-8, swelling into bar 9 - fills the seam valley chirper-zero measured
v25 THE FLOOR FALLS AWAY: the band drops out under the last chorus's third statement (bars 92-94), a snare pickup, and everyone lands with the fourth
v27 THE CHORUS ECHOES: the two whispers go; a far little choir sings the crest's line back at bar 61 and, slower and further, at bar 69 - every statement of the line now sung
v30 THE SECOND VERSE IS ANSWERED: backing ooh under its second line; the wurli answers each line with E1 upside down, so its long upside-down E1 begins as a reply
v33 THE CHORUS GETS ITS SECOND LINE: 'round and round, the middle draws us in' answers the crest's line, twice (bars 57-64)
v34 THE PRE-CHORUS: 'the nearer, the faster' over the build's climb, 'round and round and round' up to E5 in head voice
v38 THE GUITAR FLOATS: slow broken chords through a long ping-pong echo over the break, thinning as it climbs out
v53 THE VOICES GO UNDER: the backing choir hums the fall's chords, mouths closed, basses and all, softer each chord, gone when the heartbeat stops
v54 THE ORBIT TIGHTENS: an arp-pluck arpeggio of the build's chords, eighths then triplets then sixteenths into the crest; the flute steps aside for the last eight bars
